description: Land Acquisition - Kapugoda and Malinda, Dompe D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains a ministerial order authorizing the taking of possession of specific land parcels, along with detailed descriptions of the land lots, their boundaries, extents, and locations. The content focuses entirely on land matters without involving government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities, making it a clear Land Gazette (Type 4).
